overview: This paper proposes two test-time adaptation strategies for LLM agents—Syntactic Alignment (SA) and Dynamics Grounding (DG)—to address syntactic and semantic mismatches in novel environments, evaluated on WebArena, BFCLv3, and Tau-Bench benchmarks.

modules.name: Adaptation Vector Module
modules.description: Implements the lightweight adaptation vector δ for Syntactic Alignment, including its initialization as a zero vector, additive bias application to the LLM's final hidden layer before the output projection (logits′ = (H + δ)W_LM^T), and per-episode reset logic to prevent cross-episode interference.

modules.name: Online Gradient Update Module
modules.description: Implements the online update rule for the adaptation vector δ using one step of gradient descent on the cross-entropy language modeling loss (δ_new ← δ_old − η∇_δ L_CE) computed from the current input context, treating the environment observation as a self-supervisory signal for syntactic alignment.

modules.name: Persona Synthesis Module
modules.description: Generates diverse exploration personas or goals from a high-level environment description (e.g., website purpose, API documentation) by prompting an LLM to create structured persona entries (name and description) designed to probe non-obvious interactions and multi-step state transitions.

modules.name: Exploration Agent Module
modules.description: Implements the persona-driven exploration agent that interacts with the environment guided by a persona description, maintains a running list of discovered dynamics appended to its context to encourage novel actions, and collects (observation, action, new observation) transition tuples with a maximum step budget.

modules.name: Dynamics Extraction Module
modules.description: Converts raw interaction logs (observation, action, new observation tuples) into concise, human-readable environmental dynamics rules in structured JSON format containing 'initial_state', 'action', and 'environmental_dynamics' fields, using an LLM to summarize state changes.

modules.name: Dynamics Filtering Module
modules.description: Filters the extracted dynamics set E to produce a clean set E_clean by removing trivial (e.g., scrolling, pagination), repetitive, and environment-instance-specific rules while retaining rules describing unexpected state changes, new interface elements, navigation to new pages, and meaningful error conditions, using a reasoning model.

modules.name: Context Augmentation Module
modules.description: Augments the LLM agent's input context I = [p; o; {a}_{i=1}^{T-1}] by appending the filtered environmental dynamics E_clean as in-context world model knowledge (I′ = [I; E_clean]), enabling transition-aware decision making during task execution.

modules.name: WebArena Environment Interface
modules.description: Implements the interface to the WebArena benchmark including environment setup via BrowserGym/AgentLab, accessibility tree observation parsing, action space definition (click, type, hover, press, scroll, tab management, URL navigation, stop), and string-matching-based correctness evaluation.

modules.name: BFCLv3 Function Calling Interface
modules.description: Implements the interface to the BFCLv3 benchmark for multi-turn function calling, including API documentation loading, multi-turn dialogue management, exploration task synthesis for function domains, and state-based plus response-based correctness evaluation.

modules.name: Tau-Bench Evaluation Pipeline
modules.description: Implements the improved Tau-Bench evaluation pipeline including LLM-simulated user agent with deterministic temperature settings, Best-of-N sampling with self-critique mechanism to reduce evaluation variance, and reward aggregation across multiple random seeds.

modules.name: Agent Execution Loop
modules.description: Implements the main agent execution loop that orchestrates environment interaction, handles observation receipt, applies Syntactic Alignment updates and/or Dynamics Grounding context augmentation, generates actions, and manages episode termination with configurable maximum step limits.

modules.name: Metrics and Baseline Comparison Module
modules.description: Computes task success rates across benchmarks, per-website breakdowns, and comparison with baselines including WMA (World-Model-Augmented agent), standard LLM agents without adaptation, and the hybrid SA+DG configuration; computes relative latency overhead for SA.

modules.name: Ablation and Sensitivity Analysis Module
modules.description: Implements ablation studies including: exploration policy and dynamics extractor backbone variations (self vs. stronger model), dynamics filtering effectiveness comparison, syntactic alignment hyperparameter sensitivity (learning rate and training step sweeps across model sizes), and exploration episode budget analysis.

modules.name: Configuration and Experiment Management Module
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations for different models (GPT-4.1, GPT-4o mini, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct), adaptation strategies (SA, DG, hybrid, baseline), benchmarks, and hyperparameters; handles prompt templates for persona synthesis, exploration, dynamics extraction, filtering, and evaluation; supports logging and result aggregation.
